description.value: Wildwood Cabins is a cluster of four handcrafted post-and-beam cabins set on a 5-acre forested property on Bowen Island, built from local and reclaimed timber and boasting panoramic Pacific Ocean views from rock bluffs. With a 4.98-star Airbnb rating across over 3,000 reviews, the property includes a Nordic wood-fired barrel sauna, an outdoor firepit, an on-site yoga loft, and trails through old-growth forest. Cyclists arriving by ferry will find themselves within walking distance of two cideries and a farm market, with beaches and trails a short ride away.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed information about Wildwood Cabins on Bowen Island. Bike storage and staff bike procedures are not mentioned anywhere on the site. The FAQ explicitly confirms WiFi ('WIFI is good'), and the site mentions Meadowbrook Market and Alderwood Farm as nearby food/supply options. The OSM community tag reads 'Vancouver' but the property is clearly on Bowen Island — a geographic discrepancy worth flagging.
